sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Our demand forecast for this part has risen 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for sharing your data regarding the volume increase and our delivery performance, which we have reviewed. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract and 14-day payment terms from your third package. In response to your verified data, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit for this package.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €5.50 per unit.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Thank you for your revised offer and the step towards us. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Please note that the volume increase for the additional part was already factored into our previous calculation, and we have already taken that volume change data into account. In response to your movement, we are prepared to reduce our price to a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Our offer stays valid 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
